image.build_notes:
Rebuilt from scratch on the isolated bench daemon (unix:///data/docker-bench/docker.sock) with the legacy builder (DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0) and --no-cache: all 42 steps re-executed with 0 cache hits and 34 intermediate containers, so this is a genuine rebuild rather than a metadata refresh. The git-history stage fetched the Base commit from a local git-daemon mirror (VLLM_REPOSITORY=git://127.0.0.1:9418/vllm-hist.git); direct https fetches from github.com stall on vLLM's ~200MB pack on this host (transfer froze at ~11MB, reproduced twice). The source is not part of the trust argument because provenance is asserted by CONTENT inside the image: HEAD==base_commit, HEAD^{tree}==base_tree, rev-list --count HEAD>1, `rev-list --all --not base_commit` empty (nothing reachable beyond Base, so the mirror serving later commits cannot leak them), no remotes/tags, no reflog/FETCH_HEAD/ORIG_HEAD/shallow, fsck reports no unreachable objects, oracle_commit absent, and a clean worktree. All of these executed and passed in this build. The Dockerfile is byte-identical to the previously recorded build (dockerfile_sha256 unchanged); the graded verifier under tests/ is mounted by Harbor at run time rather than baked into the image.

Section VI rebuild (2026-09-07): --no-cache build from final Dockerfile. GitHub direct fetch stalls on this host (~11MB then freezes); switched to local git-daemon serving content-verified history. Dockerfile provenance guards remain effective (HEAD/tree/history/reachability all verified by in-image assertions, source URL is not the trust root).
